질문: 서울에서 수축기 혈압 140 이상 또는 이완기 혈압 90 이상인 사람은 몇 명이야?
LLM생성SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS person_count FROM fact_checkup WHERE sido_code = 11   AND (sbp >= 140 OR dbp >= 90);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS total_examinees FROM fact_checkup;
SELECT AVG(CAST(sbp AS DECIMAL(10, 2))) AS avg_sbp FROM fact_checkup WHERE sido_code = 11   AND sbp IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS person_count FROM fact_checkup WHERE fasting_glucose >= 126;

질문: 수축기 혈압이 140 이상인 사람은 몇 명이야?
LLM생성SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS person_count FROM fact_checkup WHERE sbp >= 140;

질문: 서울에서 공복혈당이 126 이상인 사람은 몇 명이야?
LLM생성SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS person_count FROM fact_checkup WHERE sido_code = 11   AND fasting_glucose >= 126;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS person_count FROM fact_checkup WHERE total_chol >= 240;

질문: 수축기 혈압이 140 이상이면서 공복혈당이 126 이상인 사람은 몇 명이야?
LLM생성SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS person_count FROM fact_checkup WHERE sbp >= 140   AND fasting_glucose >= 126;

질문: BMI가 25 이상인 사람은 몇 명이야? (BMI = 몸무게(kg) / 키(m)의 제곱)
LLM생성SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS bmi_25_over_member_count FROM fact_checkup WHERE height_cm > 0   AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL   AND CAST(weight_kg AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) / POWER(CAST(height_cm AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) / 100, 2) >= 25

질문: 수검자 수가 가장 많은 시도 코드는 무엇이고 몇 명이야?
LLM생성SQL: SELECT TOP 1 WITH TIES     sido_code,     COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS examinee_count FROM fact_checkup GROUP BY sido_code ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) DESC;
